title: 第8章 神秘境界第9章 天行健
content_zh:
肖恩望着暴跳如雷的犼，仍然是显得无比的平静，看不到有着丝毫的慌乱，完全的是一副成竹在胸的样子。
他淡然道：“是吗？我真的想看看，一个神兽残魂，在灵魂内自爆是什么样的滋味。”
犼见到肖恩软硬不吃，但自爆的代价是湮灭，太大了。
不过，以它现在这种残魂状态，也是深知很难对肖恩构成多大的威胁，只好强压心中的怒火，仍旧凶狠的道：“难道，你就不怕我对你身边的小兽下手吗？”
“来到这里，你觉得你还有这个机会吗？”肖恩撇了撇嘴，道。
他确实担心犼会对小伦下手，否则也不会疯狂到将犼引到自己的灵魂内。
不过如今，这种局面，似乎已经被他掌控。
“那就给我死吧！”
愤怒且暴戾的声音，从犼嘴中传出。
天下第一凶兽，天地独一无二的存在，也是被肖恩这种油盐不进激起了滔天的杀意。
“吼！”
无比愤怒的咆哮叫声，终于是回荡在肖恩狭小的灵魂中，一种无法形容的凶威，如同万千刀锋一般的肆虐在肖恩的灵魂深处。
“啊！”
几乎是在顷刻之间，肖恩的灵魂便是犹如雪崩一般的被撕裂，那种无法忍受的剧痛，也是令到肖恩忍不住的发出惨叫之声，双目瞬间爬满了赤红。
“卑微的蝼蚁，终于要为你的愚蠢付出代价了吧！”
察觉到肖恩灵魂的震颤，犼的神色也是凶狠了起来，下一刹那，口中再度发出惊天之吼。
“吼！”
浩浩荡荡的音波，携带着毁灭之威，最后几乎是如同在狭窄的空间投下一枚大当量炸弹一般的爆炸而开。
而犼的神色，也是充满了戏谑和残忍，没有人的灵魂，能够承受第一凶兽一吼之威，更何况它所面对的，只不过是一个微不足道的蝼蚁而已。
“先天心窍，开！”

死亡袭来，肖恩同样不失冷静，甚至，对于这道惊世的吼声产生了一种痴迷，与此同时，他那低沉的声音也是在心内响起。
嗡！
陡然间，肖恩心宫内的一道绿色光波涌入灵魂，光波缓缓旋转，竟是形成了一个绿色小旋涡。
嗤！
下一刹那，那道来自犼的狂暴吼声，竟然不可思议的被那绿色小旋涡一点点的吞噬。
“不可能，这绝对不可能，你只是一个弱小到蝼蚁般的淬元境人类小子，怎么能够吞噬我的音波？”
此刻的犼，也是咆哮出声，猩红眼睛盯着肖恩，已不复最开始的那种狠辣，而是多了一些惊惧。
一道神兽的音波，竟然会被一名仅仅只是淬元境之人吞噬。
这简直颠覆了它的人生。
这种吼声，它已经没有能力发出第三次。
“如果你没有什么手段的话，我想，应该可以结束了！”
肖恩冲着犼咧嘴笑了笑，同时，将这道声音意境紧紧的束缚在喉咙中。
“人类小子，别以为你赢了？”
犼开始变得疯狂的愤怒了起来，而它的气息，更是狂暴的升腾着。
天下第一凶兽，岂会没有自己的绝世凶性，更加的是有着宁死不屈的高傲，哪怕是湮灭于天地，也是在所不惜。
“人类小子，那就让我们一起湮灭于天地吧！”
轰！
content_en:
Sean looked at the furious Jian, who still looked extremely calm, without the slightest hint of panic, and looked completely confident.
He said calmly: "Really? I really want to see what it feels like for a remnant soul of a divine beast to explode within its soul."
When Jian saw Xiaonian, he refused to give in, but the price of self-destruction was annihilation, which was too high.
However, with its current remnant state, it also knew that it would be difficult to pose much of a threat to Sean, so it had no choice but to suppress the anger in its heart and still said fiercely: "Aren't you afraid that I will attack the little beast around you?"
"Come here, do you think you still have this chance?" Sean curled his lips and said.
He was really worried that Huan would attack Xiao Lun, otherwise he wouldn't be crazy enough to lure Huan into his soul.
But now, this situation seems to be under his control.
"Then just die!"
An angry and violent voice came from Jian's mouth.
The most ferocious beast in the world, the only existence in the world, was also aroused by Xiao En's unrestrained desire to kill.
"Roar!"
The extremely angry roar finally echoed in Sean's small soul, and an indescribable ferocity wreaked havoc in the depths of Sean's soul like thousands of blades.
"Ah!"
Almost instantly, Sean's soul was torn apart like an avalanche. The unbearable pain made Sean scream in agony, and his eyes were instantly filled with red.
"You humble ant, you must finally pay the price for your stupidity!"
Sensing the tremor in Sean's soul, Jian's expression became fierce, and the next moment, he let out a shocking roar again.
"Roar!"
The mighty sound wave carried the power of destruction, and finally exploded almost like a large-yield bomb dropped in a narrow space.
Jian's expression was also full of jest and cruelty. No human soul could withstand the power of the first ferocious beast's roar, not to mention that what it faced was just an insignificant ant.
"Innate heart aperture, open!"
When death struck, Sean remained calm. He even became obsessed with this shocking roar. At the same time, his deep voice also sounded in his heart.
Buzz!
Suddenly, a green light wave from Sean's heart palace poured into his soul. The light wave slowly rotated and actually formed a small green vortex.
laugh!
The next moment, the violent roar from Jian was incredibly swallowed up bit by bit by the small green vortex.
"Impossible, this is absolutely impossible. You are just a human boy in the Yuan Realm who is as weak as an ant. How can you swallow my sound waves?"
At this moment, Huan was also roaring, and his scarlet eyes were staring at Sean, no longer as ruthless as they were at the beginning, but more frightened.
A sound wave from a divine beast could be swallowed up by a person who was only in the Yuan Tempering Realm.
This simply turned his life upside down.
It has no ability to make this kind of roar for the third time.
"If you don't have any means, I think it should be over!"
Sean grinned at Jian, and at the same time, he tightly bound the sound concept in his throat.
"Human boy, don't think you won?"
Jian began to become crazy and angry, and its aura rose even more violently.
The most ferocious beast in the world, how could it not have its own peerless ferocity, and what's more, it has an arrogance that would rather die than surrender, even if it means being annihilated in the world, it will not hesitate.
"Human boy, then let us be annihilated in heaven and earth together!"
Boom!
